session.name: MPI-568: both targets measured, the range narrowed to 0.50-0.85, and cfg became a second slider

goal.original: Bench-evaluate the LTX spatial upscaler as the SeedVR2 successor: does it reconstruct rather than sharpen, does it keep an eye an eye, and does it clear the 16 GB ceiling that killed MPI-506.
goal.summary: The bench half is essentially answered. Target 2 measured and the VRAM ceiling is CLOSED (4.13 Mpx, one pass, 14921-15555 MB). Fabio picked 0.85 on target 1 and 0.50-or-0.85 on target 2, rejected 0.15/0.30 on every source class, and NARROWED THE SHIPPED RANGE TO 0.50-0.85. The in-between rungs were built and 0.675 is the recommended default, not yet his pick. His clothing-steer claim was tested, first reported WRONG as negative, then corrected: the prompt steers garment cut, not colour. cfg was found pinned at 1 and unpinning it amplifies steering 2.4x, so FABIO APPROVED cfg AS A SECOND, PROMPT-STRENGTH SLIDER - which reverses this card's 'one slider is the product' headline.

completed: TARGET 2 MEASURED, VRAM CEILING CLOSED. 121 frames 1344x768 -> 2688x1536 (4.13 Mpx), ONE pass, no chunking: hi_s015 512s/14921MB, hi_s030 478s, hi_s050 680s, hi_s085 732s/15555MB. A 26% BIGGER output than clip A peaked LOWER, so peak is set by the transformer, not the source

FABIO'S VERDICTS. Target 1: 0.85, overruling the 0.50 recommendation - on a low-res AI source there is no identity to preserve. Target 2: 0.50 or 0.85 on the identity trade. Both: 0.15 'a lot of motion blur, not real motion blur', 0.30 'a bit less', 0.50 'spot-on'. NOTHING BELOW 0.50 HAS EVER WON
RANGE NARROWED TO 0.50-0.85 (Fabio, 2026-08-19). The low rungs' failure mode is temporal SMEAR that a still cannot show - the eighth time a still was the wrong instrument on this card

THE IN-BETWEEN LADDER, both readings. A (same shape, lower start) WORKS: 0.60 / 0.675 / 0.75 sit 26% / 41% / 60% of the way from 0.50 to 0.85 on target 1 AND 41% / 61% on target 2 - the fractional positions match across clips, so a slider value means the same thing on different footage. B (low start, deeper tail, 6 steps) is DEAD - identical to plain 0.50. Crispness and identity are the SAME axis
SCHEDULE-SHAPE CONFOUND found, measured, and DEFLATED: shape alone is worth 1.209 against 9.538 for 0.50->0.85. The slider is effectively the start sigma and every earlier verdict stands
INVENTION HAS A SCALE LADDER, correcting an earlier 'one threshold' claim: fine texture (invented rust speckles) from ~0.675, discrete structures and identity replacement at 0.85

THE PROMPT-STEER RESULT WAS REPORTED WRONG AND CORRECTED. First read said negative, off a garment-box mean RGB (colour-only) and a crop below the collar. The prompt DOES steer garment cut - shawl prompt gives a shawl, biker prompt gives lapels+collar+studs - and does NOT repaint the jacket. Prompt POSITION has no effect (4.174 vs 3.869)

cfg IS A SECOND LEVER AND THE CONTROL SETTLED IT. cfg3-vs-cfg1 on the base prompt is 8.702 (cfg moves the image by itself), but prompt influence measured at FIXED cfg grows 3.869 -> 9.231, a 2.4x amplification. cfg 3 does NOT break the distilled transformer. Fabio approved exposing it as prompt strength
TARGET 2 PROMPT CONFOUND CLOSED: correcting the prompt moves 2.864 against the sigma's 7.812, and does not restore a replaced identity

key_decisions: THE PRODUCT IS TWO SLIDERS NOW: `sigmas` 0.50-0.85 (range DECIDED) and `cfg` exposed as PROMPT STRENGTH (approved in principle, range unmeasured). This REVERSES the card's 'one slider is the product' headline, deliberately - every closed-negative control on this card was a POST-PASS dial on a finished frame, and cfg is a sampler parameter that was never tried. A closed door and an untried door are not the same door. The old headline is annotated as superseded, not deleted. The post-pass dials stay dead: detail transfer, evidence gate, split radius, luma-only, temporal upscaler.
0.675 IS RECOMMENDED, NOT PICKED. Fabio owes the default. He has picked the RANGE and the cfg direction, nothing more.

CRISPNESS AND IDENTITY ARE THE SAME AXIS. The deeper-tail schedule was the hypothesis that they could be separated and it is dead: reconstruction happens at HIGH noise and the low-noise tail adds nothing but time. There is no clever schedule - the only way between 0.50 and 0.85 is to sit between them.

THE PROMPT STEERS CUT, NOT COLOUR. At 0.85 the sampler starts from the source latent, so it rebuilds high-frequency content (texture, garment structure) and cannot move the largest flat colour fields. A correct prompt also does NOT restore an identity 0.85 replaced.
TIME IS FLAT ACROSS THE SHIPPED RANGE - 680/714/678/732s for 0.50/0.675/0.75/0.85 on target 2, ~135-145s per second of footage at 4.13 Mpx. The user picks a look, not a cost.

THE EYE BEATS THE INSTRUMENT ON THIS CARD - but not always, and both directions cost time this session. A 1.6x zoom said the arms were softer than lanczos and 5x showed lanczos was a block grid; a mean RGB said the prompt was inert and the collar showed it was not. Match the instrument to the claim, and zoom before judging.
